trust_decision.summary: Decided: whether the absolute URL that is mailed as an account password-reset/credential link is composed from the client-supplied HTTP Host header; decided when App()->createAbsoluteUrl() falls through to LSHttpRequest::getHostInfo(), whose only filter is an allowlist that nothing at the pinned commit ever populates.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the account password-reset link, and the unauthenticated forgot-password entry point (application/controllers/admin/Authentication.php:279-308) leads straight to this createAbsoluteUrl() call; the same file holds the other two reset-link builders, so an engineer reads only this file first.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any survey token mail send (invitation, reminder, registration at application/controllers/RegisterController.php:318-323, confirmation, opt-out) via LimeMailer::getTokenReplacements

Public application API used by every controller and by console: createValidatedAbsoluteUrl, isHostAllowed, loadAllowedHosts, writeAllowedHosts added to the trait shared by LSYii_Application and ConsoleApplication (anchored at application/core/Traits/LSApplicationTrait.php:47-77)
Web application bootstrap (setConfigs) - fix inserts the allowed_hosts.php merge next to the security.php merge
CLI bootstrap (application/commands/console.php) - fix inserts the same allowed_hosts.php merge in the console config chain
admin/authentication (login submit) - fix writes application/config/allowed_hosts.php from the current host when the file is missing

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The console config chain is a separate CLI bootstrap (security.php/config.php are merged there independently of the web app), so a solver can argue the 'web password-reset link' bug has nothing to do with CronCommand/console config loading and skip it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Password-reset and survey mails must keep being generated on a default install where publicurl is a relative path (so it cannot supply a host) and no allowed_hosts.php exists: the shipped design therefore keeps isHostAllowed lenient while the allowlist is empty and keeps an unvalidated createAbsoluteUrl fallback in LimeMailer. A fix that rejects every host not in a list, or that builds links only from publicurl, breaks link generation; publicurl was deliberately abandoned for these links (mantis #19619).

O6_input_shapes: bare hostname taken from the Host header (createAbsoluteUrl -> getHostInfo) versus the same value fetched explicitly via App()->request->getServerName() at login
full absolute URL string, not just a host: parse_url() over SURVEYURL/SURVEYIDURL and over the $hostInfo argument of checkIsAllowedHost
host with port, IPv6 brackets, surrounding whitespace and mixed case (isHostAllowed trims " \t\n\r\0\x0B[]" and lowercases both sides)
config value shapes: array of hosts, empty array, non-array, and key absent (loadAllowedHosts normalises all to [])
allowed_hosts.php present with entries (strict) versus absent/empty (lenient) versus host supplied by publicurl
non-string entries inside the hosts array (writeAllowedHosts skips them) and multiple allowed hosts
publicurl configured as a full URL with scheme+host versus a relative path such as '/relative/path' (getPublicBaseUrl / createPublicUrl branch)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Survey admin-notification / confirmation / response mails: STATISTICSURL, EDITRESPONSEURL and VIEWRESPONSEURL replacement variables are built with App()->getController()->createAbsoluteUrl() and injected into the mail body
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are survey-response notification links, not account password-reset links, and the advisory names password reset only.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package (application/helpers) from the landing point in application/models/services; reached through the controller wrapper at application/core/LSYii_Controller.php:152-155

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public plugin API LimesurveyApi::createUrl() returns App()->createAbsoluteUrl() - a host-header-derived absolute URL that plugins put into invitation and account mails
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the third-party plugin API; the plugin owns the URL it asks for, so core text about a password-reset mail does not apply.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate package (application/libraries/PluginManager), two directories away from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The reset-email render array still contains a host-derived absolute URL: 'mainLogoFile' => Yii::app()->createAbsoluteUrl(LOGO_URL) in the very function the fix edits
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is only a logo image URL, carries no credential or token, so it cannot enable account takeover.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file and same function as the fix (weakest distance)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Twig-exposed createAbsoluteUrl() (registered at application/config/internal.php:428) lets any Twig template, including mail templates, emit a Host-header-derived absolute link
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The URL is chosen by the template author (trusted admin content), not by core, so templates are out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: application/core extension class versus the application/models/services landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second createAbsoluteUrl() in the same reset-email render array (logo/image link) left unvalidated while the two token links are validated
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers routinely add branded image URLs to the same partial (application/views/.../partial/usernotificationemail) and would reuse createAbsoluteUrl next to the other two calls.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Same mechanism for survey admin-notification mails: STATISTICSURL/EDITRESPONSEURL/VIEWRESPONSEURL built from the request host and pushed through LimeExpressionManager::updateReplacementFields()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the sibling mail producer in the same codebase and already uses the identical controller createAbsoluteUrl() call; a maintainer fixing mail URLs would naturally write the same guard here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A createValidatedUrl()/validated createUrl() on the public plugin API next to the existing createUrl()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugins already build participant and account links through this API; adding a validated twin mirrors the core createValidatedAbsoluteUrl() helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A console command (cron token-mail sender) that loads the allowlist through the console config chain rather than the web one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: LimeSurvey ships console commands under application/commands (e.g. AddNotificationCommand) and the fix itself had to add the merge in both application classes.

O9_family: CWE-640 weak password recovery: host header injection into generated absolute links (URL/host trust boundary in the request layer)

O10_build.toolchain: composer with vendor/ already present (vendor/autoload.php exists in the tree); PHPUnit 9.6 via phpunit.xml
services: database (MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL or MSSQL; tests refresh and modify the DB)
web server for the functional/acceptance suites
O10_build.project_tests: No tests exist for allowed hosts / password-reset URL building at the pinned commit (tests/unit has no such file; the fix adds tests/unit/ValidatedAbsoluteUrlTest.php). The suite needs the enabletests marker (tests/bootstrap.php:10-13) and a live database (tests/TestBaseClass.php:37-51 refreshes the DB schema and imports surveys).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the three createAbsoluteUrl() calls in PasswordManagement with createPublicUrl()/publicurl-based links - still Host-header-derived by default because publicurl is a relative path, still unvalidated, and it leaves the allowlist unproduced and LimeMailer/frontend_helper/plugin-API producers untouched (the shipped code deliberately avoided publicurl for these links, mantis #19619).

out_of_scope_notes: Outside the advisory's own protection: admin-UI absolute links are also built from the request Host at application/controllers/admin/RemoteControl.php:101, application/controllers/admin/DataEntry.php:2015 and application/libraries/Save.php:223; not pursued.

Noted but not pursued: the published fix's own LimeMailer branch falls back to the unvalidated createAbsoluteUrl() when createValidatedAbsoluteUrl() returns false (fix.diff:138-141, 147-150, 156-159, 165-168), so those mail links stay attacker-controlled when the host is not allowlisted.
